actions.name: scanned the company’s systems to determine if the systems were susceptible to a specific vulnerability
actions.description: Unidentified individuals scanned Equifax’s systems on March 10, 2017 to determine if they were susceptible to a vulnerability in Apache Struts Web Framework.

actions.name: discovered a server housing Equifax’s online dispute portal running vulnerable software
actions.description: Unidentified individuals discovered a server running a version of Apache Struts containing the vulnerability.

actions.name: gained unauthorized access to the Equifax online dispute portal and confirmed ability to run commands
actions.description: Using software designed to exploit the vulnerability, attackers gained unauthorized access and confirmed command execution capability on the portal.

actions.name: gained access to the online dispute portal and used techniques to disguise activity
actions.description: Beginning May 13, 2017, attackers accessed the portal and used encrypted communication channels to disguise queries and commands to other systems.

actions.name: issued queries to other databases to search for sensitive data
actions.description: After gaining system-level command ability on the portal, attackers queried other databases to find PII and unencrypted credentials.

actions.name: leveraged credentials to expand access to additional databases
actions.description: Attackers used unencrypted usernames and passwords to access 48 additional unrelated databases beyond the initial 3.

actions.name: ran approximately 9,000 queries to extract PII from databases
actions.description: Attackers ran about 9,000 queries, some successfully returning PII, while disguising their presence by blending with normal network activity.

actions.name: removed extracted PII in small increments using encrypted web protocols
actions.description: Attackers exfiltrated stolen data over about 76 days using encrypted web protocols to disguise the data removal as normal traffic.
